pages.text: Earn $(bold)progression tokens$(), bank them up to your tier's threshold, and the Codex advances you automatically.$(br2)Four $(bold)lanes$() earn tokens (Engineering, Magic, Exploration and Combat), and all of them feed $(bold)one combined pool$(). No lane is mandatory: any one of them, played on its own, can reach the threshold, and hybrids can mix them freely.

pages.title: The Four Lanes
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Engineering$(): submit bulk metals and milestone machines (Create, then Thermal, then Mekanism).$(li)$(bold)Magic$(): submit cultivation reagents and apparatus (Botania, Ars Nouveau, advanced rituals). Only cultivation counts, never spellcasting.$(li)$(bold)Exploration$(): tokens for entering new dimensions, looting chests and kills.$(li)$(bold)Combat$(): tokens for boss and miniboss kills.

pages.title: Two Routes per Tier
pages.text: Reach $(bold)either$() target and you advance, whichever comes first:$(br)$(li)$(bold)Tokens$(): bank the threshold ($(t2){{tier 1 threshold}}$() for Tier 2, $(t3){{tier 2 threshold}}$() for Tier 3, $(t4){{tier 3 threshold}}$() for Tier 4).$(li)$(bold)Boss Rush$(): clear a share of the tier's bosses ($(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() for Tier 2, $(t3){{tier 2 rushpct}}$() for Tier 3, $(t4){{tier 3 rushpct}}$() for Tier 4).$(br2)Tier 4 is the final gate. After it, the Ender Dragon is the finale (see $(l:icraft:progression/tier_unlock_checklist)Targets & Boss Rush$(/l)).

pages.title: Submitting & Tracking
pages.text: $(bold)To submit:$() run $(bold)/icraft codex submit$(). It scans your inventory and banks everything that counts, consuming those materials.$(br2)$(bold)To check progress:$() run $(bold)/icraft codex balance$() to see your token total against the threshold.$(br2)$(note)Tokens are physical items: Codex Token I, II and III, one per tier transition.$()
